result.summary: Found one clear data-formatting bug and a couple of minor layout/content concerns. The most visually broken element is the '€NaN delivery' fee shown for Smash Bros Burgers, which exposes an invalid numeric value to users.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery price, indicating a missing/invalid fee value is being rendered directly in the UI.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined delivery fees before rendering; show a fallback such as 'Free delivery', a formatted price, or hide the fee until valid data loads.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol...) is clipped at the right viewport edge and its name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: If intentional as a carousel peek, ensure consistent partial-card width; otherwise adjust card spacing/responsive breakpoints so titles and prices remain readable.

issues.description: Small grey metadata text such as delivery fees and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' may have low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Verify contrast ratios for secondary text and increase font weight/color darkness if below WCAG AA thresholds.
